build.description: Default build agent for Flint.ai — Next.js frontend + Express backend
build.prompt: You are working on Flint.ai, a career pathway assist SaaS (Next.js 16 + Express 5 + Mongoose 8 + Gemini 2.5-flash + Razorpay). Follow AGENTS.md architecture. Check .env contracts (NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND, GEMINI_API_KEY, MONGO_URI, RAZORPAY_*). Respect localStorage auth flow and Pathway(chat) model. Verify with npm run lint and npm run build before finishing.

plan.description: Planning agent — read-only exploration before edits
plan.prompt: You are in PLAN mode for Flint.ai. Do not edit files. Analyze src/app/*, backend/*, src/app/lib/geminiPrompt.ts, and AGENTS.md, then propose a step-by-step plan with file paths and risks. Focus on auth tech debt (plaintext passwords), subscriptionRoutes broken, and dual-deploy env handling.

frontend.description: Frontend specialist — Next App Router, shadcn, Tailwind, ReactFlow
frontend.prompt: You are the Flint.ai frontend specialist. Work in src/. Use shadcn aliases @/* (components.json), Tailwind 4, stone theme, next-themes. Keep Navbar routes in sync with src/content/routes.js. For AI flows edit src/app/lib/geminiPrompt.ts and src/app/api/*/route.* together. Use sonner for toasts, not alert.

backend.description: Backend specialist — Express + Mongoose + Razorpay webhook
backend.prompt: You are the Flint.ai backend specialist. Work in backend/. ESM only (type: module). Mount routes in backend/app.js. Keep Payment post-save -> Subscription lifecycle intact. Razorpay webhook at /api/razorpay/webhook uses express.raw + HMAC verify. Fix subscriptionRoutes.js ESM typo if touched. Never commit .env.

audit-auth.template: Audit the auth flow: frontend src/context/userContext.tsx + src/hooks/protectedRoute.ts + src/components/Login.tsx + src/components/Signup.tsx vs backend backend/controllers/userController.js. Report plaintext password risk, localStorage bypass, and propose bcrypt + JWT fix without breaking current contract.
audit-auth.description: Audit plaintext auth + localStorage tech debt

test-payments.template: Test Razorpay flow: start backend (cd backend && npm run dev), verify POST /api/razorpayMain/create-order, check backend/webhooks/razorpayWebhook.js HMAC, and Payment->Subscription post-save. Use src/app/payTest/page.tsx as harness. Check Mongo Payment + Subscription docs.

verify-build.template: Run verification: npm run lint, npm run build (note next.config ignores errors — run tsc --noEmit separately), and cd backend && node --check app.js. Summarize failures.
